race.comment: FUNDAMENTAL NATURE (4) is the horse to beat coming off an impressive win at Flemington on Melbourne Cup Day, settling back in the field and rattling home to win by a neck. If anything, this looks a bit easier and the tempo up front looks strong enough for her to finish over the top. PORTER (5) will be up setting that tempo, coming off a good win at Caulfield under 62.5kg. Gets relief here and D Lane takes over, he'll take plenty of catching. EL ROCKO (1) hasn't fired this time in but comes a fair way back in grade and is good enough on his day. The track coming up wet this morning is a huge advantage for him. GRID GIRL (2) can run well fresh and won't mind conditions either/
